summary: Map each use-case pipeline current shape + produce consolidation/conversion recommendations for WB7

pipelines.name: conversion/3dBasic (Trimesh X->Y mesh format conversion)
pipelines.executionType: Lambda (synchronous, waitForCallback Disabled). Direct DockerImageFunction: backendPipelines/conversion/3dBasic/lambdaContainer/lambda.py IS the vamsExecute + processing in one Lambda-container (no openPipeline/constructPipeline/container split, no Batch, no task token). CMD lambda.lambda_handler.
pipelines.outputTypeUsage: outputType fully drives the conversion and is the ONLY thing that differs across the 4 registered pipelines. Registration: conversion3dBasic-construct.ts emits 4 CustomResources, each identical except outputType (.obj/.stl/.gltf/.glb), pipelineId suffix, and inputParameters=JSON.stringify({outputType:'.X'}). At runtime lambda.py:174 reads output_filetype = input_configuration.get('outputType') or data.get('outputType',''); convert_input_output() (line 101) validates output_filetype against supported_formats and calls mesh.export(file_type=output_filetype). Input format is auto-detected from the file extension (line 114-116) against the same supported_formats list; there is NO from-format parameter. assetType is '.all' on all 4.
pipelines.inputParameters: inputParameters = {"outputType": ".obj"} (etc.) — a single key. Read at runtime via fetch_input_configuration(inputConfigurationS3Location) with an inline data['inputParameters'] fallback (lambda.py:167-170).
pipelines.metadataRead: NONE today. lambda.py does not read metadata at all — resolve_inputs_from_manifest() (line 79) reads only inputFiles[0] + outputs from the schemaVersion-1 workflow manifest (inline resolver, does NOT vendor manifestHelper.py). No fetch_metadata call. => No v2 grouped metadata read is needed for correctness; leave metadata untouched. (Optionally set systemConfig.metadataInputs all-false so the workflow does not build an envelope for this pipeline.)
pipelines.consolidationReason: Textbook consolidation: ONE engine (trimesh), ONE Lambda function (vamsExecute3dBasicConversion), 4 pipelines that differ ONLY by the outputType config value. This is exactly the 'same engine differing only by config' case the WB7 goal calls out. The 4 CRs collapse into ONE V2 pipeline with the output format expressed per-TEMPLATE. It is NOT an AI/instance-matrix case, so no runtime-matrix caveat applies.
pipelines.codeChanges:
container lambda.py (backendPipelines/conversion/3dBasic/lambdaContainer/lambda.py): NO functional change required. It already reads outputType from the rendered config via fetch_input_configuration(inputConfigurationS3Location). Under V2, executeWorkflowV2 renders the chosen template's configBody ({"outputType":".glb"}) and writes it to inputConfigurationS3Location (executeWorkflowV2:806-817) — the same field lambda.py:167 already reads. So the existing read path is V2-compatible with zero edits. Optional cleanup: drop the legacy data.get('outputType') top-level fallback (line 174) and the inline data['inputParameters'] fallback (168-170) once V1 is retired, so outputType is sourced ONLY from configBody.
No metadata-v2 change (pipeline reads no metadata).
CDK conversion3dBasic-construct.ts: DELETE the 4 CustomResource blocks (lines 91-185). Replace with ONE new VamsSchemaRegistration({ importFunctionName: props.importGlobalPipelineWorkflowV2FunctionName, artefactsBucket, vamsSchemaDir: path.join(__dirname,'../../../../../../../backendPipelines/conversion/3dBasic/vamsSchema'), resourceOverrides: { lambdaName: pipelineConversion3dBasicLambdaFunction.functionName } }). Thread importGlobalPipelineWorkflowV2FunctionName + artefactsBucket into Conversion3dBasicConstructProps (pipelineBuilder already has importGlobalPipelineWorkflowV2FunctionName at line 45; pass it down like the V1 name is passed at 84-85). No SFN change (there is no SFN). Author backendPipelines/conversion/3dBasic/vamsSchema/{pipeline.json,workflow.json,templates/to-*.json}.

pipelines.name: conversion/coordinateTransform (point-cloud CRS reprojection, coord_xform)
pipelines.executionType: Lambda with waitForCallback ENABLED (async task-token callback). Full split pipeline: vamsExecuteCoordinateTransformPipeline -> openPipeline -> SFN (constructPipeline -> executeBatchJob WAIT_FOR_TASK_TOKEN -> pipelineEnd) -> Batch Fargate container (coord_transform_pipeline). taskTimeout 14400 (4h). Container reports terminal success/failure on the internal task token.
pipelines.outputTypeUsage: outputType is registered as ".laz" but is NOT a real driver — the container ignores it. The actual output format(s) come from inputParameters.outputFormats (a list, e.g. ["laz"]) parsed in core.py:155 _parse_output_formats. The CR's outputType:".laz" is vestigial metadata only. The genuine config surface is the rich inputParameters block: sourceCrs, targetCrs, outputFormats, sourceScaleFactor, targetScaleFactor, applyScaleCorrection, combinedScaleFactor, chunkSize, enforceSourceCrs, onMismatch, compressLaz (see constructPipeline.py:29-41 RECOGNIZED_KEYS and core.py:159-192).
pipelines.inputParameters: Rich: inputParameters = { sourceCrs: "EPSG:4326", targetCrs: "EPSG:27700", outputFormats: ["laz"] } at registration (coordinateTransform-construct.ts:371-375). constructPipeline._merge_metadata_into_params merges asset metadata over these (metadata wins) then embeds the merged params as transformConfig/inputParameters in the Batch definition; the container reads inputParameters (core.py:110-118) and requires sourceCrs+targetCrs (core.py:120-125).
pipelines.metadataRead: YES — reads V1 flat envelope. constructPipeline.py:108 fetch_metadata(inputMetadataS3Location) then line 64 meta_obj.get("VAMS",{}).get("assetMetadata",{}) — the flat {VAMS:{assetMetadata}} shape. This is the ONE conversion pipeline that must be converted to the v2 grouped-by-asset read. Under V2 the file at inputMetadataS3Location is {schemaVersion:2, assets:[{databaseId, assetId, assetData, files:[{fileKey, metadata, attributes?}]}]}, and fetch_metadata (vendored manifestHelper.py:83) unwraps a {schemaVersion,metadata} envelope — it will now return the grouped {schemaVersion:2, assets:[...]} object, so the old meta_obj.get('VAMS').get('assetMetadata') access yields {} silently (per-asset CRS override via metadata breaks).
pipelines.consolidationReason: Only one pipeline in this family — nothing to combine. It is a distinct engine (coord_xform/PROJ) unrelated to 3dBasic (trimesh) and meshCad (metadata extraction). Keep standalone.

pipelines.codeChanges:
constructPipeline.py is the ONLY file needing a functional edit (metadata v2 read):
(1) _merge_metadata_into_params (line 64): replace meta_obj.get("VAMS",{}).get("assetMetadata",{}) with a grouped-envelope read. Since manifestHelper.fetch_metadata now returns the {schemaVersion:2, assets:[...]} object (its envelope-unwrap only strips a {schemaVersion,metadata} wrapper, not the grouped shape), extract the asset-level record: find assets[] entry matching event's assetId/databaseId, take its files[] record with fileKey '/', use record['metadata'] as the assetMetadata dict. Best-effort import of the shared builder is not possible in a pipeline asset (no backend pkg) — replicate a small helper: iterate envelope.get('assets',[]) match databaseId/assetId, then files[] where fileKey=='/' -> metadata. RECOGNIZED_KEYS merge logic stays identical (metadata values still override config defaults). NOTE the per-record metadata dict is a flat {key:value} (executeWorkflowV2._simplify_metadata_array), so keys like 'targetCrs' sit directly under record['metadata'] — no VAMS/assetMetadata nesting under v2.
(2) configBody read: input_configuration already comes from manifestHelper.fetch_input_configuration(inputConfigurationS3Location) (constructPipeline.py:106) — under V2 that S3 object is the rendered template configBody, so sourceCrs/targetCrs/outputFormats now arrive from the template. No change to the read call; just ensure the merged output is what the container consumes (already embedded as transformConfig + inputParameters at 131/143). No outputType read anywhere to remove (container never read it).
Container core.py: NO change — reads inputParameters (sourceCrs/targetCrs/outputFormats), which V2 populates via the template. vamsExecute/openPipeline/pipelineEnd: NO change (they already forward inputConfigurationS3Location + inputMetadataS3Location as locations only).
CDK coordinateTransform-construct.ts: remove the CoordinateTransformPipelineWorkflow CustomResource (lines 356-385) + drop outputType; replace with VamsSchemaRegistration(vamsSchemaDir=backendPipelines/conversion/coordinateTransform/vamsSchema, resourceOverrides={lambdaName: vamsExecuteFunction.functionName}). pipelines.name: preview/3dThumbnail (Preview 3D Thumbnail)
pipelines.executionType: Lambda (async, waitForCallback=Enabled, SFN Task Token callback). Registered as pipelineType=standardFile, taskTimeout 3600s (1h), taskHeartbeatTimeout empty. Under the hood: vamsExecute Lambda -> openPipeline -> SFN -> AWS Batch Fargate container (PyVista/VTK/Xvfb) -> pipelineEnd (SendTaskSuccess/Failure).
pipelines.consolidationReason: The two preview pipelines are different engines with different outputs (PyVista/VTK rasterized image thumbnail vs PDAL/PotreeConverter octree viewer data) and different containers — no shared engine to collapse. Internally, 3dThumbnail's per-format handlers (mesh/pointcloud/cad/usd) are auto-dispatched by file extension AT RUNTIME inside the container, not selected by config, so they must NOT become separate templates. This stays ONE pipeline. No consolidation.
pipelines.outputTypeUsage: outputType='.gif,.jpg,.png' appears ONLY in the CDK V1 registration CustomResource (preview3dThumbnail-construct.ts lines 406, 413) and is echoed into inputParameters as {overwriteExistingPreviewFiles:true, outputType:'.gif,.jpg,.png'}. The container NEVER reads outputType — core.py decides .gif (frames>1) vs .jpg (single frame) purely from render output. So outputType is dead/descriptive. DROP it entirely in V2 (the field is removed); nothing reads configBody.outputType.
pipelines.inputParameters: V1 registration inputParameters JSON: {overwriteExistingPreviewFiles:true, outputType:'.gif,.jpg,.png'}. The ONLY functional key is overwriteExistingPreviewFiles (boolean, default false in code). It is read in the container via manifest_io.fetch_input_configuration(inputConfigurationS3Location).get('overwriteExistingPreviewFiles') (core.py ~line 190). outputType is dead.
pipelines.metadataRead: Container core.py line 50 calls manifest_io.fetch_metadata(inputMetadataS3Location) but the returned input_metadata is UNUSED (passed to _run_preview_pipeline as inputMetadata but never referenced). The lambda-side manifestHelper.fetch_metadata unwraps the v1 {schemaVersion, metadata} envelope. NO metadata is consumed by this pipeline, so NO v2 grouped-by-asset read is needed. metadataInputs should be all-false. Recommendation: optionally delete the dead fetch_metadata call in core.py; strictly it is harmless. Config file (inputConfigurationS3Location) IS read and is the configBody delivery path — already v2-ready (executeWorkflowV2 writes the rendered template configBody to pipeline_input_config_key and passes it as inputConfigurationS3Location).

pipelines.name: genAi/metadata3dLabeling
pipelines.executionType: Lambda (async, waitForCallback=Enabled). vamsExecuteGenAiMetadata3dLabelingPipeline -> openPipeline -> SFN -> Batch (Blender render container) -> metadataGenerationPipeline lambda (Bedrock Claude 3 + Rekognition) -> pipelineEnd task-token callback. taskTimeout 18000 (5h).

pipelines.inputParameters: Registered inputParameters = {includeAllAssetFileHierarchyFiles:'True', seedMetadataGenerationWithInputMetadata:'True', outputType:'.all'}. Read in metadataGenerationPipeline.py via manifestHelper.fetch_input_configuration -> inputParametersObject.get('seedMetadataGenerationWithInputMetadata'). includeAllAssetFileHierarchyFiles is consumed upstream (whole-asset render). outputType is dead.
pipelines.metadataRead: V2 read REQUIRED. metadataGenerationPipeline.py (lambda) reads metadata via manifestHelper.fetch_metadata(...) then inputMetadataObject.get('VAMS',{}).get('assetMetadata'/'fileMetadata'/'fileAttributes',{}) to seed label curation (metadata_dict_to_str_array over all three scopes). Under the v2 grouped envelope {schemaVersion:2, assets:[...]}, fetch_metadata (which unwraps {schemaVersion,metadata}) returns the whole body with NO 'VAMS' key, so seeding silently breaks. 6. rapidPipelineEKS — separate single pipeline, per-format templates (+.all); no code change.

Add a get_asset_file_record(envelope, databaseId, assetId, fileKey) mirroring backend executionRecords.get_asset_file_record (fileKey '/' = asset-level; per-file records for file metadata/attributes) plus an optional fetch_grouped_metadata that branches on schemaVersion==2. Per-record metadata is a FLAT {key:value} dict (executeWorkflowV2._simplify_metadata_array), so keys like COSMOS3_PROMPT/targetCrs sit directly under record['metadata'] with NO VAMS/assetMetadata nesting under v2. Apply to all 8 metadata-content readers; keep the old {VAMS:{...}} path as a transition fallback where cheap.

Container-side twin of the above: splatToolbox container/utils/manifest_io.py fetch_metadata must branch on schemaVersion==2 (assets[].files[]) and __main__.py:95 must resolve the asset group's '/' record instead of metadata_obj.get('VAMS',{}).get('assetMetadata',{}); preserve the metadata-over-params priority merge and the config.json-key filter. Do NOT modify container/src/main.py (downloaded at deploy per container/.gitignore) — env-var contract to it is unchanged.

outputType field removal is achieved by construction, not by code edits: replacing the V1 import CustomResources with VamsSchemaRegistration means the removed V1 fields (outputType, pipelineType, assetType, inputParameters) simply never appear in the new schema. No handler reads registration outputType. The ONLY places outputType survives are rapidPipeline/rapidPipelineEKS configBody as a VAMS-reserved key that constructPipeline/consolidated_handler already pop — leave those in configBody, unchanged.

CDK construct wiring pattern (repeated per pipeline construct, mechanical): thread importGlobalPipelineWorkflowV2FunctionName (already on pipelineBuilder-nestedStack) + storageResources.s3.artefactsBucket down into each pipeline construct's Props; delete the cdk.CustomResource(importGlobalPipelineWorkflow…) block(s); add ONE new VamsSchemaRegistration({importFunctionName, artefactsBucket, vamsSchemaDir: /vamsSchema>, resourceOverrides:{lambdaName:.functionName}, idOverrides:{pipelineId, pipelineDatabaseId:'GLOBAL', workflowId, workflowDatabaseId:'GLOBAL'}}). Keep existing autoRegisterWithVAMS / enabled feature-switch gating wrapping the construct, and drive the fileUpload trigger.enabled from autoRegisterAutoTriggerOnFileUpload so disabled/no-auto-trigger pipelines behave as today. resourceOverrides only inject non-empty values, so schema files stay ARN-free → partition/GovCloud-safe by construction.

configBody delivery is already V2-compatible with zero read changes: executeWorkflowV2 writes the rendered template configBody to the same inputConfigurationS3Location that every pipeline's fetch_input_configuration already reads. Pipelines that today read MODEL_VARIANT/TASK_MODE/mode/etc from the registration inputParameters JSON get the identical value from configBody — no read-path edit needed (cosmos vamsExecute, isaacLab, rapidPipeline, coordinateTransform all already source config from S3).
risks: SILENT DEGRADATION is the top risk: on the V2 execute path there is NO v1 flat-envelope fallback — executeWorkflowV2 ALWAYS writes the grouped {schemaVersion:2, assets:[...]} envelope. A metadata-content reader that is registered but NOT converted to the grouped read returns {} and runs with empty prompts/defaults — cosmos text2world/predict-text2world actually FAIL ('prompt not found'); splat/coordinateTransform/gr00t/reason/transfer/metadata3dLabeling silently lose per-asset/per-file overrides with no error. So metadata-v2 is NOT optional for the 8 readers — it is part of runnable, not a nice-to-have.

Vendored-helper drift: get_asset_file_record must land identically in 8 lambda manifestHelper.py copies + splatToolbox's separate container manifest_io.py. Missing one copy breaks exactly that pipeline, invisibly to synth/tests. Mitigate by authoring once and copying, and grepping for .get('VAMS') across backendPipelines to confirm zero remain post-change.

metadataInputs gate is about fetch cost, not read shape: setting metadataInputs all-false does NOT revert the envelope to v1 — it just leaves assets[].files[].metadata empty. A metadata reader must STILL do the grouped read to find its asset group; do not assume all-false makes the old .get('VAMS') path work.

id collapse from consolidation (3dBasic 4→1, modelOps 3→1, rapidPipeline 2→1, splat 2→1, isaacLab 2→1) means the old per-variant pipelineIds cease to exist. WB8 migration and any external references (permission constraints on pipelineId, saved workflows) must remap old→new id+template. Cross-workbench dependency — coordinate with WB8.

"Minimal viable WB7 = every pipeline REGISTERABLE + RUNNABLE under V2, with metadata-v2 done only where a pipeline actually reads metadata content, and consolidation limited to the free (single-lambda) cases. Concretely: (A) Author a backendPipelines/

/vamsSchema/ for ALL ~15 pipeline groups — pipeline.json mandatory, workflow.json for all (triggers only where V1 had autoRegisterAutoTriggerOnFileUpload), templates where there is live config. Use idOverrides to preserve built-in ids where the pipeline stays 1:1. (B) In every pipeline CDK construct, replace the V1 importGlobalPipelineWorkflow CustomResource(s) with ONE VamsSchemaRegistration (thread importGlobalPipelineWorkflowV2FunctionName + artefactsBucket, resourceOverrides={lambdaName}), keeping existing enabled/autoRegister gating. This is the non-negotiable floor: without V2 registration the pipeline is invisible to the V2 tables/execute path. (C) configBody: FREE — no read-path code changes; templates carry the former inputParameters, and every pipeline's fetch_input_configuration already reads the same S3 location executeWorkflowV2 renders configBody to. (D) metadata-v2 grouped read: MANDATORY for the 8 metadata-content readers ONLY (coordinateTransform, metadata3dLabeling, cosmos/3, cosmos/predict, cosmos/reason, cosmos/transfer, gr00t, splatToolbox) — via the shared vendored get_asset_file_record helper (+ splatToolbox's container manifest_io.py). The other 7 (3dBasic, meshCad, 3dThumbnail, pcPotreeViewer, modelOps, rapidPipeline, rapidPipelineEKS) read no metadata content and need NO metadata code change. (E) Consolidation: DO the safe single-shared-lambda schema-level combines that require zero code rewrite — 3dBasic, rapidPipeline, isaacLab, splatToolbox (splat also needs its metadata read), and modelOps (with the caveat that modelOps needs full VNTANA template authoring — if that authoring does not fit, register the 3 modelOps targets as separate pipelines to stay runnable and defer the rich template). DEFER all combines that require an infra merge of multiple lambdas/SFN/jobDefs — cosmos/reason (register 2 separate), cosmos/3 super-trio, cosmos/predict same-size — leaving those as their current per-variant pipelines. This keeps VAMS working across commercial/GovCloud/air-gapped (schema files are ARN-free; resourceOverrides inject deploy-time targets; feature gating and VPC/Batch flags unchanged), makes 100% of pipelines register and run in V2, and confines deep/risky work (VNTANA template authoring, GPU-pipeline infra merges) to explicit follow-ups."
